notes: p7-10: Columns are list letters as headed (B Demócrata Cristiano, C Conservador Unido, D Vanguardia Nacional del Pueblo, E Radical, G Comunista, H Demócrata, I Liberal, J Socialista, K Democrático Nacional); only lists running in each grouping are recorded. 'NULOS Y EN BLANCO' is one figure ('nulos y blancos'); no valid-vote column is printed.

p7-10: Rows printed indented in lower case under a commune in capitals are recorded as units with that commune (e.g. Huara under Iquique, Chuquicamata and San Pedro de Atacama under Calama, Sewell under Machalí, Cachapoal under San Fabián). On p8 the six Valparaíso rows (Las Zorras, Cordillera, San Agustín, Delicias, Barón, Juan Fernández) are printed in capitals and closed by 'TOTAL VALPARAISO'; they are recorded as units of commune Valparaíso with that row as level 'commune' (Juan Fernández included because the printed total includes it).
p7-10: p8 Calera Liberal and Ocoa Liberal are smudged ('2 '', '1,4'); set to 251 and 194 from each row's total general, and these give the printed Quillota department Liberal total 3.157.

p7-10: p9 Liberal column (grouping 5, Rancagua and Cachapoal/Caupolicán departments) is blurred; most cells were settled from the row total (Machalí 432, Sewell 158, Graneros 312, Codegua 116, Mostazal 328 (looks like 323; 328 closes both row and department), Doñihue 371, Coltauco 181, Peumo 454, Las Cabras 155, El Manzano 318, Rengo 475, Pichiguao 51, Quinta de Tilcoco 181, Requínoa 375, Olivar 168, Coinco 525, Malloa 331, Pumanque 125, Pichilemu 157).
p7-10: p9 Chépica total general reads '1.386' but the row adds to 1.886 and the Santa Cruz department total 17.895 requires 1.886; recorded 1886 (the first digit is a misread/blurred 8).

p7-10: p9 Departamento Rancagua: printed Lista D 11.445 (clear), but its communes add to 11.446, the row's own sum is 31.859 against printed total 31.860, and the O'Higgins province total 15.306 matches 11.446. Printed figure kept; volume error.

p7-10: p9 Departamento Caupolicán Lista I: the last digit of '2.10?' is a 5/6 overstrike (closed lower loop at 300 dpi, enlarged); recorded 2106, which the communes (sum 2.106), the row's own total (13.991) and the O'Higgins province Liberal total 7.100 all require.
p7-10: p10 Rafael (Tomé): Lista G printed 95 (clear at 300 dpi), but the row adds to 650 against printed total 648, and Departamento Tomé Lista G 2.095 implies 93. Printed 95 kept; volume error.

Groupings 1, 3 and 5 totals read here equal the reference file exactly.
p11-14: Pages 11-14 cover the end of grouping 7 (rest of Concepción province from the Coronel department, Arauco province, TOTAL 7a.), all of grouping 9, and the TOTAL REPUBLICA row.

p11-14: Column D (Vanguardia Nacional del Pueblo) is a dash in every grouping 7 and 9 row and is omitted (list not running there); column H (Demócrata) is a dash in every grouping 9 row and is omitted there. Lebu and Los Álamos print '-' under nulos y blancos: recorded 0. Río Mayer (p13) prints dashes in every column including the total: recorded as all zeros.

p11-14: Department total rows print only 'TOTAL DEPARTAMENTO'; each is named after its first (head) commune, e.g. Coronel, Yumbel, Lebu, Arauco, Cañete, Valdivia, La Unión, Río Bueno, Osorno, Río Negro, Puerto Montt, Puerto Varas, Maullín, Calbuco, Aysén, Coyhaique, General Carrera (communes General Carrera and Baker), Ancud, Castro, Achao, Chaitén, Magallanes, Puerto Natales, Porvenir (Porvenir and Navarino). These names are inferred, not printed.

p11-14: Indented names printed under a capitalized commune are treated as civil circumscriptions of that commune (e.g. Monte Águila under Yumbel, Máfil under Mariquina, Melinka under Quellón). Printed 'Shoshuenco' is transcribed as Choshuenco; 'Buta-Chauques' as Butachauques.

p11-14: p13 Coyhaique TOTAL DEPARTAMENTO, Liberal: the middle digit looks like 863 but is blurred; 883 is used because the units sum to 733+64+86=883, the row closes only with 883 (total 2.359), and the Aysén province Liberal total 1.445 requires 883.
p11-14: p13 Palena total general: reads like 250 but the row sums to 260 and the Chaitén department total 951 requires 260; 260 is used.
p11-14: TOTAL REPUBLICA (p14) is recorded as level national with all list columns B..K including D and H; it adds up across (639.707).
